test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following books is written by Megasthenes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indica.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Megasthenes compiled information about India in the book Indika/Indica, which is now a lost work and only survives in quotes quoted by later writers in their books.

 
• Megasthenes visited India sometime between circa 302 BCE and 288 BCE.
 
• Megasthenes was an ancient Greek historian, diplomat, and Indian ethnographer.
 
• He was an ambassador of Seleucus Nicator I, in the court of Chandragupta Maurya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vigyaneshwar composed a book called Mitakshara which is a commentary on **Yajnavalkya Smriti**.
 
• It is also called a legal book.
 
• Kalidasa wrote Megadutam, **Malvikagnimitram.**
 
• Banabhatta is the author of **Harshacharita and Parvatiparinay.**
